test_title: PYST 45: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 30 Sept, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Select the sentence that has a grammatical error.

options.text: The sun rises in the east.
We watches movies every Friday night.
He works as a software developer.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect conjugation of the verb **"watch"** in the simple present tense.
 
• In the simple present tense, the subject "we" (a plural subject) should be followed by the base form of the verb **"watch"** without an "-es" at the end.
 
• The correct form should be **"we watch"** instead of **"we watches"**.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"We watch movies every Friday night."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "She always eats healthy meals."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 2: "The sun rises in the east."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4: "He works as a software developer."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
